user.title: House wiki
user.description: Gives voice assistants read-only access to notes kept in a GitHub repo (for example an Obsidian vault). Use a fine-grained token limited to that one repository with Contents: Read-only.

error.invalid_auth: GitHub refused the token for that repository. Check the token's repository access and the owner/name.

abort.single_instance_allowed: The house wiki is already set up.

init.title: Pages in scope
init.description: One entry per line. Everything under an included folder is read. Pages under a mention folder are read only when they contain one of the mention terms. Any path containing an excluded text is skipped.
